name: kr_reconstruct_request
purpose: Start an async job decompiling a cooked BP's bytecode into editable K2 graphs (whole copy or single function) with truthful tallies.
engineApi: CreateEditableBlueprintCopy (CompiledBlueprintReconstructor.h:37-38, KISMET_API); MifReconstructFunctionIntoGraph (MifReconstructPipeline.h:15, plugin-private); FKismetEditorUtilities::CreateBlueprint/CompileBlueprint (KismetEditorUtilities.h:124,169); FBlueprintEditorUtils::CreateNewGraph/AddFunctionGraph (BlueprintEditorUtils.h:329,390). No export promotion under model (b).
cooked: the reason it exists — works on .pak-mounted UBlueprintGeneratedClass with stripped graphs; loose sources accepted (harmless, noted in response)
prevents: create_editable_child runs the same pipeline synchronously and reports nothing about reconstruction quality; decompile half reachable only via MIF_KR_DEBUG console command
overlaps: K1:kr_reconstruct_function (mode=function duplicates it — ship one shape at merge)
hazards: Job slot is single-flight — second request while queued/running fails with jobId in message
FGCScopeGuard held per function; ~40-function BP caused crash + 8s GC stall (MifReconstructCommand.cpp:43) — game-thread only, slice at BP/function granularity
ok:true on the HTTP envelope never implies clean compile — caller must read compile.errors
Ubergraph refused in mode=function — events reconstructed per-event by copy pipeline only
Events reconstructed iff mif.kr.Events CVar is 1 (default 1)

name: kr_reconstruct_status
purpose: Poll the single kr job slot: phase, per-function/event done-counts, node counts, compile numbers, and final result for any kr job kind.
engineApi: None beyond plugin job record (MifKrJobManager); counters from bound delegate lambdas (MifKismetReconstructorModule.cpp:18-37) and FKismetGraphDecompiler::GetNodesCreated/GetStatementsProcessed/WasDegraded (KismetGraphDecompiler.h:76-78). No export promotion.
overlaps: K1:kr_batch_reconstruct_status (unify on this shared-slot poll design at merge)
hazards: HTTP pump is a game-thread ticker (HttpServerModule.h:25,:60) — polls answer between ticks only; no mid-BP progress for single-BP jobs, payload says so
Job records are in-memory only — gone after editor restart, found:false
Must be registered read-only or every poll pushes an empty undo entry

name: kr_verify_fidelity
purpose: Reconstruct+compile a throwaway transient child of a cooked BP, diff recompiled vs cooked bytecode, return the fidelity report as numbers.
engineApi: GetBlueprintFidelityVerifier delegate + FBlueprintFidelityReport (CompiledBlueprintReconstructor.h:109-113, :71-104); MifKr VerifyBlueprint (MifFidelityVerifier.cpp:432-433). REQUIRES ONE NEW ENGINE-FORK EXPORT: KISMET_API RunHeadlessFidelityVerify (refactor of file-static VerifyFidelityCmd body, CompiledBlueprintCopyAction.cpp:1356-1470; RunReconstructOnce is namespace-static, unlinkable).
cooked: designed for cooked sources; also accepts authored/loose testbed BPs deliberately (ground-truth loop, CompiledBlueprintCopyAction.cpp:1393-1395)
prevents: mif.kr.VerifyFidelity console command prints log lines a bridge agent cannot read; save-then-delete workaround would churn AssetRegistry per verify
overlaps: K1:kr_verify_fidelity (NAME COLLISION — K1 proposes conflicting synchronous design and differently-shaped export RunBlueprintFidelityVerify; merge must pick one; async form here better supported by cost evidence)
hazards: Multi-second on any real BP (full child reconstruct + one CompileBlueprint + double disassembly + strict/lossy double emission) — must be async
score/adjustedScore must be null when HasScore() false — NEVER 1.0 and never the -1 sentinel
Failed compile ⇒ fidelity not measured (score null) — a number over stale bytecode is a lie
CHILD-ONLY by design: sibling copies report systematic false drift on component refs — no variant param exists on purpose
735/1250 corpus BPs are all-event ⇒ scored:0, score:null, never 1.000

name: kr_drift_census
purpose: Fidelity verify across a path-filtered set of cooked BPs, sliced one BP per tick, with live totals over HTTP and the DriftCensus CSV.
engineApi: Shares RunHeadlessFidelityVerify export (no additional engine change); plugin-side FARFilter enumeration mirroring batch harness (CompiledBlueprintCopyAction.cpp:102-119, :1167-1186); mif.kr.DriftCensus CVar (MifDriftClassifier.cpp:66-71) scoped-forced to 1 via IConsoleVariable::Set.
cooked: cooked-only BY DESIGN (PKG_Cooked gate) — loose BPs are exactly what the census must not dilute
prevents: mif.kr.ReconstructAll/VerifyFidelity console runs need a human babysitting a console for an hour; rules must be written from data, not guessed
overlaps: K1:kr_batch_reconstruct_request (distinct purpose — drift census vs pass/fail sweep — but both must share ONE job slot at merge)
hazards: IsCompiledBlueprintAsset gate is engine-static and REIMPLEMENTED plugin-side — deliberate documented duplication, citation is the sync contract
GC every 25 BPs required (mirrors CompiledBlueprintCopyAction.cpp:1303)
Editor crash mid-census: flushed per-BP BEGIN log marker + startIndex resume cursor are the recovery path
Default maxCount 50 bounds accidental whole-corpus runs; maxCount:0 is the explicit run-everything
Census CSV unopenable ⇒ job continues, censusCsvPath null (diagnostic only, verdicts unaffected)

name: kr_classify_drift
purpose: Per-function drift verdicts for one BP: verdict class, deduped intentional reasons, and root-cause first-unclaimed edit for real drift.
engineApi: Shares RunHeadlessFidelityVerify export; plugin-side FVerdict + Classify (MifDriftClassifier.h:28-46, :55-56) captured via a module-static per-function verdict sink armed inside VerifyBlueprint (MifFidelityVerifier.cpp gains the sink). No export promotion.
cooked: as kr_verify_fidelity — cooked sources plus authored testbeds
prevents: kr_verify_fidelity's aggregate counts and single firstDrift string cannot drill down to per-function root causes
hazards: Engine delegate arity must NOT be widened — lockstep engine+plugin hazard refused on principle (CompiledBlueprintReconstructor.h:54-56); sink lives plugin-side
Classifier declines on caps (2000 statements / 4.2M LCS cells / 200k sim iterations) ⇒ conservative verdict:drift with classifier-declined:cap reason
Static sink is race-free only because the pipeline is game-thread-only by existing contract
function filter naming an unattempted function ⇒ found:false plus attempted list, never a silent empty row
